hazards.control: Certified lifting gear; casing and tubing handling by trained crews.
Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Cement evaluation (bond log)
function: The logs run inside the casing after the cement sets that estimate where the cement is and how well it bonds to the pipe and the formation.

tabs.overview: A sonic tool measures how much the casing rings; well-bonded pipe rings less. Ultrasonic tools map the bond around the pipe. A temperature survey finds the top of cement from the heat of hydration. The completion uses the result to decide whether stages will be isolated behind pipe.
tabs.engineering: Run on wireline after the cement sets; interpretation depends on the cement and the casing.
tabs.connections: Run through the wellhead with a wireline unit (WL).
tabs.evidence: API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), API RP 10D-2 (S30), field practice (S9). Sizes are public nominal values; the schematic depth is not to scale.
tabs.operations: Before the frac when isolation matters.
tabs.failure_modes: Ambiguous logs, microannulus, foam cement effects.
